equipment: Air Production Unit (APU) Compressor, Metro do Porto, Portugal

TP2.description: Pressure measured directly on the compressor outlet port.

TP3.description: Pressure generated at the pneumatic panel feeding the braking and suspension circuits.

H1.description: Pressure drop across the cyclonic oil separator filter.

DV_pressure.description: Pressure drop during the discharge of air dryer towers (drops to ~0 when loaded).

Reservoirs.description: Compressed air pressure in the downstream main air storage reservoirs.

Motor_current.description: Electric current consumed by one phase of the 3-phase compressor electric drive motor.

Oil_temperature.description: Operating lubrication oil temperature inside the compressor mechanical block.

COMP.description: Air intake valve electrical signal (active/1 when compressor is offloaded or off).

DV_eletric.description: Compressor outlet discharge valve control signal (active/1 under load).

Towers.description: Desiccant drying tower selection signal (0 = Tower 1 active, 1 = Tower 2 active).

MPG.description: Motor Pump Governor electrical signal triggering load cycle when pressure < 8.2 bar.

LPS.description: Low Pressure Switch electrical signal triggering emergency warning when pressure < 7.0 bar.

Pressure_switch.description: Switch detecting the cyclical discharge/regeneration event in the air-drying towers.

Oil_level.description: Discrete safety sensor indicating when compressor oil level falls below safe limits.

Caudal_impulses.description: Flow impulses measuring the absolute volume of compressed air delivered to reservoirs.
